technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average of present used technology

# Included processes
This module includes the European production of newsprint paper without the use of deinked pulp (waste paper) - including transports to paper mill, wood handling, mechanical pulping and bleaching, paper production, energy production on-site and internal waste water treatment.; Geography: Data from a finnish database and from several European newsprint producers used as European average data.
